subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined issue remain open as the Control UI umbrella, or should maintainers split it into a Control UI structured-reply contract plus the existing final-fallback delivery issue?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol shape, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, and final fallback delivery policy; automation should not choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open until the structured reply metadata path and durable final-fallback semantics are accepted or replaced.

options.title: Split To Canonical Trackers
options.body: Close or narrow this only after a maintainer creates or confirms a Control UI-specific reply-metadata tracker and points no-output delivery to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Treat Markdown Quote As Enough
options.body: Declare the current Control UI quote-text behavior sufficient and intentionally drop the structured reply-target request.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the structured reply metadata path and durable final-fallback semantics are accepted or replaced.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the broadest routing signal across the prior triage and the overlapping Control UI, agent runtime, and delivery-policy surfaces.
